title: HB 597 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2 and Title 49, relative to elections.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) 2-7-112(c)(3) (Sec. 1, rewritten subsection)
(quote) (3) An identification card issued to a current student by a public institution of higher education containing a photograph of the student;
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) 2-6-201(a) (Sec. 3, replaces section)
(quote) A registered voter is not required to provide a reason in order to cast an absentee ballot by mail; provided, that the voter submits a certification as to the identity of the voter, on a form prescribed by the secretary of state, with the application for a by-mail absentee ballot.
(section) 2-6-202(a)(3)(G) (Sec. 4, replaces item)
(quote) (G) The certification required under § 2-6-201.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec. 1 (rest): rewrites the 2-7-112(c) list; other items appear to reprint existing ID types (passport, driver licence, state/federal photo ID, employee ID, military ID, retired state employee ID).
(other) Sec. 2: deletes 2-2-115(b)(7) (existing text not saved).
(other) Sec. 3 (b): a non-defective absentee ballot cast under (a) must be counted, including in a recount.
(other) Sec. 5: deletes the words 'or that category of persons otherwise' in 2-6-401(c).
(other) Sec. 6: deletes 2-8-101(b) (existing text not saved).
(other) Sec. 7: rules take effect on becoming law; all else July 1, 2021.
(other) version: 2278294-Draft: Draft only; carries slots a and c: adds public-college student photo ID to 2-7-112(c), and makes a signed identity certification (not an ID number or ID copy) the condition of a by-mail absentee ballot without a stated reason.
(other) note: Only the Draft is saved. The certification form is to be prescribed by the secretary of state; the text does not say what it contains. Failed in House Elections & Campaign Finance Subcommittee 2021-03-03; no roll call saved.
